description:
Configure the 'rack_power_main' input to log data to two separate feeds with different resolutions. 

1. Navigate to the Inputs page and locate 'rack_power_main' (Node: server_room).
2. Configure its input processing list to log to a NEW feed named 'rack_power_live' with a 10-second interval.
3. Add a second logging process to log to a NEW feed named 'rack_power_archive' with a 30-minute (1800s) interval.

Ensure both feeds are created and the processing chain is saved.
